tagline: General, cosmetic and implant dentistry in Ashtown, Dublin 15
status_pill: Accepting new patients - next available Tue 29 Apr 2026

hero.body: General, cosmetic and implant dentistry in Ashtown, Dublin 15. Three dentists, one hygiene team, published fees, and a waiting room that isn't trying to sell you anything.

team.name: Dr. Aoife Ni Dhalaigh
team.bio: Aoife opened Rathborne Dental in 2014 after seven years in practices in Galway and south Dublin. She places every implant in the practice and leads on full-mouth rehabilitation cases.

team.name: Dr. Conor Whelan
team.bio: Conor handles all orthodontic planning at Rathborne and is an accredited Invisalign provider. He trained at Trinity and spent four years in a busy North Dublin practice before joining in 2019.

team.name: Dr. Priya Raghavan
team.bio: Priya leads on children's care and nervous-patient cases. She completed a clinical master's at RCSI in paediatric dentistry and works with referrals from GPs and schools in the area.

services.title: Examinations, fillings, hygiene
services.body: Standard six-monthly care with two-film intraoral X-rays at the first visit. We flag everything we see, quote before we treat, and never sell you what you don't need.

services.title: Whitening, bonding, veneers
services.body: In-chair whitening takes 90 minutes. Composite bonding is a single visit. Porcelain veneers are two visits spread over two weeks with a try-in.

services.title: Clear aligners
services.body: Digital scan at consultation, full treatment plan shared with you before any commitment. Most Lite cases finish in 5-6 months; full treatment 12-18 months.

services.title: Single implants and bridges
services.body: Straumann and Neodent systems. Every case starts with a CBCT scan on-site. Healing time of three to four months is built into the plan and the price - no surprise add-ons at the restorative stage.

services.title: Same-day triage
services.body: Ring before 10am weekdays for same-day triage. We will see you the same day if clinically urgent; consultation first, treatment planned with a quote before anything is done.

services.title: First visits & PRSI-covered care
services.body: Children eligible for PRSI Treatment Benefit get their annual exam free. We also work with GP referrals and school dental referrals. First visits from age 2-3.

testimonials.quote: Aoife rebuilt three molars I'd been hiding for a decade. She quoted the whole thing on the first visit, to the euro, and it didn't move.
testimonials.author: Cian

testimonials.quote: We brought our six-year-old to Priya after a bad experience elsewhere. He now asks when we're going back.
testimonials.author: Niamh

testimonials.quote: I came in for a check-up and left with a proper plan for the work I'd been putting off, written down, priced to the euro. No pressure, no up-sell.
testimonials.author: Liam

faq.a: We don't dispense treatment under the Medical Card scheme, but we do accept PRSI Treatment Benefit for exams and scale/polish. Bring your card to the first visit and we'll process it for you.

faq.q: How long is a first visit?
faq.a: 45 minutes. Full intra-oral exam, two bitewing X-rays, gum health screening, and a written treatment plan with prices.

faq.q: Can I get a quote before I commit?
faq.a: Yes - that's the point. Every treatment plan is written, itemised and priced to the euro before anything is done.

gdpr.retention: We retain clinical records for 8 years per DPC guidance, 12 years for minors.
